summary: Prove in Rocq, on the integer pair tower at every level, that a z = 0 exactly when z a = 0 (Corollary 9.3 of math/0511691) through the purity of annihilators, with direct finiteness as corollary, and retain the kernel receipts.

reconciliation.note: Opened from the closed plan cd-one-sided-inverses, whose next_action named this Rocq statement as the open follow-up (action item 7 of math-0511691.md). Scope read from the note's Lemmas 2 to 4, theorem and corollary and from the tower definitions of CdImaginarySumConference.v.

scope: proofs/CdAnnihilatorSymmetry.v, requiring proofs/CdImaginarySumConference.v unchanged: the norm law, the trace-form adjoint identities, the purity of annihilators, the kernel equality and direct finiteness with the integer-cleared right-inverse family, each for every element of the integer tower at every level; the bundle docs/evidence/cd-annihilator-symmetry/ with replay script, receipts and source hashes, wired into the Rocq replay job, the Kaggle replay driver, the ledger test and formalization.yaml. The real-coefficient tower and Lemma 9.2's identity x(x*y) = x*(xy) stay out of scope.

steps.action: State and prove norm_mul, adjoint, purity_left, purity_right, kernel_equality, right_inverse_affine and direct_finiteness on the tower of CdImaginarySumConference.v by induction on the doubling, under rocq 9.3.0 with -w @all and no axiom.
steps.acceptance: Fails if rocq compile prints any output, if any Print Assumptions query prints other than Closed under the global context, or if a step needs associativity, division or a real-number axiom. Stop condition: a doubling case the induction cannot close is recorded and ends the step.

receipts.result: CdAnnihilatorSymmetry.v compiles under rocq 9.3.0 with -w @all and no output; all eleven Print Assumptions queries print Closed under the global context and rocq check passes; every step cancels a nonzero integer <x, x> and none divides or uses associativity.

steps.action: Retain assumptions.v, assumptions.txt, kernel.txt, toolchain.txt, source_hashes.sha256 and replay_rocq.sh under docs/evidence/cd-annihilator-symmetry/, and name the bundle in ci/gates.json (shellcheck gate), ci/rocq_changed.sh, the ci.yml replay selection, scripts/rocq_kaggle_replay.py, tests/test_evidence_ledgers.py and formalization.yaml.
steps.acceptance: Fails if replay_rocq.sh departs from its receipts, if ci/check_rocq_ci_pins.py reports the bundle missing from any surface, if the ledger test rejects source_hashes.sha256, or if formalization.yaml fails the retained v0.4 schema.

receipts.result: replay_rocq.sh passes against its receipts in 23 s; ci/check_rocq_ci_pins.py reports 13 bundles agreeing; tests/ci/test_rocq_ci_pins.py and tests/test_evidence_ledgers.py pass (58 tests); formalization.yaml validates against the retained v0.4 schema with jsonschema 4.26.0; check_markdown_links.py resolves every link.

Revalidation after the merge with main and the automation-model note: replay_rocq.sh passes against its receipts; ci/check_rocq_ci_pins.py reports 13 bundles agreeing; tests/ci/test_rocq_ci_pins.py and tests/test_evidence_ledgers.py pass; formalization.yaml validates against the retained v0.4 schema with jsonschema 4.26.0; check_markdown_links.py resolves every link.

Revalidation at the revision that bridges every functor theorem: edits recording Lemma 9.5, Corollary 2.9, the ordered-domain functor and its bridges changed bound note, map and index files, and the acceptance reruns: the cd-annihilator-symmetry, cd-annihilator-symmetry-real and cd-tower-domain replays pass against their receipts and sha256sum -c accepts each ledger; tests/test_evidence_ledgers.py and tests/ci/test_rocq_ci_pins.py pass (16 unmarked, 44 audit) under the pinned interpreter; ci/check_rocq_ci_pins.py reports 15 bundles agreeing; formalization.yaml validates against the retained v0.4 schema with jsonschema 4.26.0; check_markdown_links.py resolves every link of 705 files.

resolution: kernel_equality and direct_finiteness hold for every element of the integer pair tower at every level in proofs/CdAnnihilatorSymmetry.v, closed under the global context; the bundle replays against its receipts and every Rocq surface names it. The real-coefficient tower and Lemma 9.2's identity stay open.

receipts.result: Both steps are done with receipts at the revision that carries the proof, the bundle and the wiring.
